admission.justification: Provider remediation before the report or without an explicit order could restart a forbidden stack and erase the incident evidence.

applicability: Provider or system remediation considered by an Investigator.
conditions: An explicit authorized developer or actual-parent order permits remediation.
An active alert forbidding starts still forbids provider start or restart.
exclusions: Code, memory, task, closeout or integration changes remain forbidden.

evidence: test_role_instruction_wording.py: exact remediation and order clauses

statement: Provider or system remediation requires an explicit developer or actual-parent order after the report.
